geometry_proposal.use_as: tolerance context only; independently regenerate from the exact published canonical plan and recalculate service and costs

service_policy: Use the exact published Samawah planning seed without demand or timetable overrides.
open_assumptions: The route screen is unsurveyed and does not establish right-of-way, crossings, utilities, ground, access or buildability.
Existing civil classes are proportionally transferred and require route-specific reassessment.
The city's demand and operating plan remain planning assumptions from the published outline.
Class C calculations are not supplier quotations, physical validation or project-finance approval.
